title: Quantified Prioritization Matrix for Private/VPC Quarterly Roadmap
creator: Mariana Lopez
description: Create a quantified prioritization matrix and acceptance gate for Q3 features targeting Private/VPC/on-prem customers. Deliverable will map candidate features to company OKRs, estimate engineering effort, surface regulatory/compliance blockers, and produce a ranked backlog with explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria for the quarterly plan. This ticket synthesizes input from Sales (customer asks), Solutions (onboarding complexity), Security (KMS/HSM & audit), and Engineering (runtime readiness). The matrix will be used by PM, Eng leads, and GTM to finalize the Q3 roadmap and to set measurable targets for each feature (SLO improvements, install time, cost-per-token delta, customer onboarding time).
acceptance_criteria: A prioritization matrix spreadsheet published with score breakdown for at least 12 candidate items
Each candidate has: estimated dev effort (T-shirt), engineering risk, compliance gating, target OKR mapping, projected customer impact metric
Stakeholder sign-off (Eng, Security, Sales, Solutions) recorded in comments
Final ranked backlog and recommended cut line for Q3 delivery published to the PM roadmap Confluence page
KPI targets for each included item documented and linked to Redwood OKR tracker
tasks: Collect feature candidates from Sales/Customer Success and Solutions (deadline 2026-03-17)
Run initial scoring workshop with Eng leads and Security (2026-03-19)
Quantify customer impact using recent onboarding dashboards and support tickets
Finalize matrix and run GTM prioritization sync (PM/Eng/RTC)
Publish roadmap slice and update console release calendar
comments: 2026-03-11 — Initial intake: collected 14 candidate features from Sales (Ben). Notable asks: HSM integration PKI, zero-downtime private upgrades, split billing for dedicated pools.
2026-03-12 — Engineering note (Ravi): KV cache eviction by tenant will require runtime changes and ~4 weeks of focused PR work; flags as high engineering risk.
2026-03-12 — Security note (Aisha): HSM/KMS integrations require a formal security review and FIPS checklist; mark as compliance-gated for Q3 inclusion.
2026-03-13 — PM workshop summary: scored candidates across Impact (0-5), Effort (0-5), Risk (0-5), Strategic Alignment (0-5). Agreed to weight Impact 40%, Effort 25%, Risk 20%, Alignment 15%.
2026-03-14 — Design feedback (Mei Chen): Console surfaces for private rollout need a consult flow; recommend prototype before dev starts (adds 1 sprint to lead time).
2026-03-14 — Decision: recommend promoting 'Private Upgrade Wave Orchestration' and 'Tenant-level KV cache' into Q3, deprioritize 'Custom billing UI' to Q4 unless enterprise commit received.
decisions: Use weighted scoring (Impact 40%, Effort 25%, Risk 20%, Alignment 15%) for final ranking
Require security_review_required gate for any item touching KMS/HSM or audit logs
Cut line recommendation: include top 5 ranked items by default; reserve 1 slot for high-revenue customer commitments
Prototype design for console consult flow required before engineering work for rollout UX features
risks: Compliance gating for KMS/HSM could delay HSM-dependent features by >=6 weeks (mitigation: start security review early)
Runtime changes (tenant KV eviction) could regress latency SLOs if not shipped with canary policies (mitigation: plan canary + A/B rollout and traffic shaping)
Resource contention: Dedicated pool capacity for large enterprise customers may push back availability (mitigation: reserve burst capacity in Dedicated roadmap)
Scope creep from Sales commitments — require signed contracts for items outside top-5 to avoid roadmap churn
next_steps: Finish candidate scoring sheet and attach to this ticket (owner: Liam) by 2026-03-17
Schedule GTM prioritization sync with Sales and Solutions for 2026-03-20
Trigger security intake for HSM/KMS candidates on 2026-03-17
Publish final ranked backlog and update roadmap Confluence by 2026-03-21
